description: Source file defining the MainActivity class for an Android-based simple calculator app. It manages UI components, input logic, basic arithmetic operations, and visual styles for the calculator.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main entry point of the Android calculator app, managing user interface, input processing, and calculation logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, event listeners, and layout transitions.

methods.name: setUpStyling
methods.description: Applies elevation and rounded styling effects to UI components.

methods.name: setUpListeners
methods.description: Attaches click listeners to number buttons, operator buttons, and control buttons.

methods.name: resetState
methods.description: Resets calculator internal state and updates display.

methods.name: updateDisplay
methods.description: Updates the calculator display with optional fade-in animation.

methods.name: handleDigit
methods.description: Processes digit button presses, updating input and display.

methods.name: parseCurrentInput
methods.description: Converts current input string to Long, handling invalid formats.

methods.name: applyPendingOperator
methods.description: Applies the pending arithmetic operator to the accumulator.

methods.name: handleOperator
methods.description: Handles operator button clicks, updates operator state, and visual emphasis.

methods.name: emphasizeOperator
methods.description: Visually highlights the selected operator button.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Performs calculation based on current input and operator, shows result, and resets operator state.
